node.label: Brothers to the Rescue
node.definition: Brothers to the Rescue (Spanish: Hermanos al Rescate) is an American activist nonprofit organization based in Miami, Florida, headed by José Basulto, who testified that he had been a CIA operative. Formed by Cuban exiles, the group is widely known for its opposition to the Cuban government and its former leader Fidel Castro.
